title: Boosting the Pseudocapacitive and High Mass-Loaded Lithium/Sodium Storage through Bonding Polyoxometalate Nanoparticles on MXene Nanosheets

notes: Spine: POM fade/rate need -> bond POMs on MXene hypothesis -> MXene base + MF POM modification -> in-situ ambient growth -> dispersion + small size + chemical interface -> pseudocapacitive dominance (joint causes: dispersion, size; MEC synergy) -> rate capability, high-loading capability; interface -> cycling stability -> down-select as LIC/SIC anode -> LIC and SIC Ragone FOMs -> conclusion. Audits: F1d HAADF shows 50-200 nm bright plates, 10-20 nm particles not resolved (o3a); F3c retention ~37% vs 51% in text (o15). Packet issues: F1 caption says d) HRTEM but panel d is HAADF-STEM; F1e/F1f caption spans carry body text; F4 caption says CV at 5.0 mV/s but panel annotation says 2.0 mV/s; F5g y-axis labelled 'Energy density (Wh kg-1)' on a half-cell capacity plot; F6g has no crop in the panel section; F6 linked text gives current densities 0.4-4.2 A/g but F6b legend is 0.1-2.0 A/g (0.4-4.2 is the voltage window); F4e/f/g OCR annotations 'hime (s)' are neighbour-axis bleed. Not in graph: Raman (F2b, only in o6 image_note), EIS (F4e/F6e), device cycling (image_notes), GITT diffusion coefficients and SEI chemistry (supporting figures only), Na redox-couple assignment of CV peaks (text only), Li-side CV comparison F3a (image_note of o19).
